title: 스토킹범죄 사건의 심리 및 재판 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 스토킹범죄 사건의 심리 및 재판 등에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 4 (Inclusion in the Period of Pretrial Detention) Where a measure under Article 9 (1) 4 of the Act has been taken, the period of custody under that measure shall be deemed a period of detention before the pronouncement of judgment as provided for in Article 57 (1) of the Criminal Act.
